admission.scope: Independent factual equivalence and data-minimization approval for bounded SEC-sourced historical research/navigation among nine admitted legal filers. No blanket proprietary-identifier licensing clearance.
constraints: Label links as matching reported instruments and reporting filers at 2026-06-30, not all investors, company-level ownership, legal ownership or current positions.
Keep different security classes and depositary receipts distinct; do not broaden the exact-match rule to fuzzy names or issuer consolidation.
Retain all original position rows, source lineage and reporting-manager references. An equivalence link must never deduplicate source holdings or multiply values.
Do not sum across filers into a purported unique economic exposure or ownership percentage. Existing combination-report, overlap and amendment qualifications continue to apply.
Absence of an equivalence group is unknown/unmatched, not proof of no holding or a different issuer.
Publish only opaque source-scoped memberships; do not publish raw proprietary identifiers, hashes derived from those identifiers, source XML or a reusable identifier-value lookup.
This review does not establish a blanket license for commercial identifier-derived data redistribution or third-party commercial feeds. Those uses require a separate rights review.
Vanguard Global Advisers is solely CIK1811242, not parent CIK102909 or the entire brand. Keep its realignment/non-additive perimeter qualification visible.

The VGA Apple row and existing managed/voting evidence claims describe the same source position. Instrument matching must not turn those representations into additional economic exposure. Retain distinct role predicates and test the non-additive linkage.
This admission covers exact instrument memberships, not application integration, browser QA, permission to publish or an automatic merge.
admission.reviewMethod: Separate independent implementation reconstructed exact date, raw source identifier, trimmed class, quantity type and option key from every eligible SEC XML row using normalized source ID and ordinal. All memberships, source/input hashes and eligibility counts compared. CUSIP syntax and checksum checked without correcting values. No names used for cross-filer matching.
